# Check if there are any opponents that appear more than once in master series finals
# First, filter rows where outcome is either 'winner' or 'runner - up' (since those are finals)
finals_df = df[df['outcome'].isin(['winner', 'runner - up'])]

# Group by opponent and count occurrences
opponent_counts = finals_df['opponent'].value_counts()

# Check if any opponent appears more than once
any_duplicate_opponent = (opponent_counts > 1).any()

# The claim is "never faced the same opponent in more than one master series finals"
# This is true if there are no duplicate opponents, false otherwise
answer = not any_duplicate_opponent
